family.description: This family includes SnoaL [[cite:PUB00021066]] a polyketide cyclase involved in nogalamycin biosynthesis. This family was formerly known as DUF1486. The proteins in this family adopt a distorted alpha-beta barrel fold [[cite:PUB00021066]]. Structural data together with site-directed mutagenesis experiments have shown that SnoaL has a different mechanism to that of the classical aldolase for catalysing intramolecular aldol condensation [[cite:PUB00021066]].
family.name: SnoaL-like polyketide cyclase
